column16: Vimeo is committed to providing granular and transparent data in accordance with the Digital Services Act. To this end, we have worked to the best of our ability to organize and map our internal moderation data to the specific categories and subcategories defined by the regulator. Due to current system and tooling limitations, and in the spirit of full transparency, the following disclosures include global data collected during the reporting period across all reporting channels. It is important to note that while we strive for total alignment, our internal flagging systems and community guidelines may not always correspond perfectly with the regulator’s standardized terminology. In such instances, we have applied a "best-fit" methodology to ensure that our disclosures remain as accurate and representative as possible. We continue to mature our internal reporting infrastructure to improve the precision of these mappings in future reporting cycles.
